codexlint.analyzer.command.description: Choose which analyzer command preset to run.

codexlint.analyzer.customCommand.description: Custom analyzer command text, for example: codex exec --model gpt-5. Ignored unless Analyzer Command is set to custom.

codexlint.analyzer.customInput.description: How codexlint passes prompt text to a custom analyzer command. Ignored for codex exec and claude -p presets.

codexlint.prompt.highlightSelectedSkills.description: Highlight selected skill names in the prompt text. Models can still access all skills regardless of this setting.

codexlint.prompt.selectedSkills.description: Comma-separated or newline-separated skill names to highlight in the prompt.

codexlint.prompt.customPrompt.description: Use a custom prompt template. See README.md for template guidance.

codexlint.prompt.customPromptText.description: Custom prompt template. Ignored unless Use Custom Prompt is enabled.

codexlint.operation.enabled.description: Run codexlint security analysis when a file is saved.

codexlint.operation.debounceMs.description: Delay before launching analysis after save.

codexlint.operation.maxFileBytes.description: Skip files larger than this size in bytes.

codexlint.operation.timeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait for analyzer output.

codexlint.operation.showDebugCommand.description: Show the 'codexlint: Debug Environment' command in the Command Palette.

codexlint.operation.showDebugIO.description: Log analyzer request/response text to the codexlint output channel. Request logs omit file content.

scripts.build:release: npm run build:verify && node prepare-dist.mjs && cd dist && vsce package --no-dependencies
scripts.build:verify: npm run build:clean && npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.compile: npm run lint && npm run compile:extension && npm run compile:test
scripts.test:setup: npm audit --omit=dev && npm run compile && node -e "fs.mkdirSync('test-workspace',{recursive:true})"
scripts.test: npm run test:setup && vscode-test && npm run test:teardown
